results.title: Open vs. closed AI: How behind are open models? | Epoch AI
results.content: **For the purpose of this report, “open” AI models are defined as those with downloadable model weights (including those with restrictive licenses), while “closed” AI models are either unreleased or can only be queried in an API or hosted service.** We use this classification to compare the benchmark performance and training compute of open and closed AI models over time, measuring how far open models lag behind. **In terms of training compute, the largest open models have lagged behind the largest closed models by about 15 months.** The release of Llama 3.1 405B relative to GPT-4 is consistent with this lag, at 16 months. By studying trends in benchmark performance and training compute, we have found that the best open models lag behind closed models across every metric. closed AI models reveals the best open model today matches closed models in performance and training compute, but with a one-year lag.
